extensionDescription.message: ThunderAI Sparks is Thunderbird add-on, designed to add advanced features to ThunderAI.

prefsInfoDesc_1.message: ThunderAI Sparks is an experimental add-on for Thunderbird, designed to add advanced features to ThunderAI. To use this add-on you need to install ThunderAI.

prefsInfoDesc_2.message: Get ThunderAI from the Thunderbird Add-ons page!

TranslateText.message: Do you want to help translate ThunderAI and ThunderAI Sparks?

calendar_categories_warning_title.description: Title of the native warning shown when the categories proposed for a calendar event cannot all be set.

calendar_categories_limited.message: This calendar limits event categories. Some proposed categories could not be included. Review the event before saving.
calendar_categories_limited.description: Native warning: the calendar of the new event accepts fewer categories than proposed, so some were left out.

calendar_categories_unavailable.message: Event categories could not be applied. Review the event before saving.
calendar_categories_unavailable.description: Native warning: setting the categories of the new event failed; the event is still created without them.
